evidence.exact_quote: PM persists Free Models trusted source state, source resolver outcomes, source refs, release/tag/commit/npm/changelog/source hashes, current and previous imported catalog snapshots, import disposition, check cadence/timestamps, stable internal imported ids, and alias/rename/provider-move mappings. Storage keeps underlying provider/account/model/source identity intact and stores secret material only as credential references, never raw secrets.

items.impact: Upstream churn or interrupted imports can destabilize settings and Usage history despite stable internal IDs.
items.statement: SP-224 preserves current and previous catalog snapshots, aliases, source hashes, and credential refs, but it does not define atomic promotion, retention beyond one previous snapshot, alias collision resolution, rollback selection, or behavior when source identities disappear.
items.title: Free-model snapshot retention and rollback selection are unspecified
